metadata.description: AgroSmart Soil Image Dataset Manifest (P1.1 Deduplication)
metadata.audit_discrepancy_explanation: The audit text referenced 462 canonical images by subtracting 8 from 470. In reality, the 8 quarantined images are low-resolution Alluvial thumbnails belonging to the 8 cross-class pairs. Their high-resolution Clay counterparts were retained as canonical. Thus 470 unique canonical scenes exist (Alluvial: 122, Red: 128, Black: 116, Clay: 104), with exactly 8 thumbnails quarantined and 193 duplicates archived.
